The advantages and disadvantages of EfficientDet model used in substation personnel detection and location are proved by experiments, and the possible improvement direction in the next step is discussed. The research results of this paper can also be applied to the environment of personnel location and detection in other power grid systems with a few changes.

articleTitle: Optimization Method of Active Rush-Repair for Distribution Network Based on the “Marketing-Distribution-Dispatch” Integrated Rush-repair Network
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: At present, the rush-repair schedule of distribution network becomes an important factor which affects the reliability of power grid.The four problems that affect the process of rush-repair are as follows: 1) Failure to receive complete failure information; 2) Fault diagnosis depending on personal experience; 3) The process of dispatching is cumbersome; 4) Lack of experience summary after rush-repair. The above factors affect the fault judgment of dispatchers, slowing down the command response speed and prolonging the rush-repair progress and outage time of power failure.To solve the above problems, this research is put forward. An active rush-repair strategy based on association relation method is proposed. An intelligent fault diagnosis based on BP algorithm is proposed. To optimize the process of dispatching command, "Marketing-Distribution-Dispatch-Repair" rush-repair database is proposed. The case analysis shows that the research plays a positive role in the rapid judgment of fault causes, the acceleration of rush-repair command speed and the shortening of fault outage time. This research will help to improve the power supply reliability of power grid.

articleTitle: Establishment of electric vehicle battery management system based on DSP And SOC accurate estimation
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, the application DSP (TMS320LF2407)-based hardware systems, and according to the given topology, the completion of the entire electric vehicle battery management system (BMS) platform structures. Then use matlab/sinulink simulation of the required battery model and estimation algorithm accuracy, reliability and suitability. In order to facilitate system debugging, also designed the input-output system and PC data receiving system. Finally, build a test platform for the simulation of lithium iron phosphate groups working condition test, get the battery state of charge (SOC) estimation error of less than 5%. Which can be obtained with this test platform software system, the battery model and estimation algorithm is correct.

articleTitle: Adequacy Analysis of New Energy Access Power System Based on Monte Carlo Simulation(CICED 2020)
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, the stochastic model of wind power generation is considered. Under all possible load conditions, the ability of power system to meet the demand of system load power supply, i.e. the adequacy of power system, is studied. Through Monte Carlo simulation method, the adequacy of power system in a given area is calculated and analyzed, and the reliability indexes such as load loss probability are studied. In order to further Considering the adequacy of various energy systems provides a reference value.

articleTitle: Research and Test of 10kV ZnO Thermal Stability Based on Finite Element Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The zinc oxide surge arrester is an important barrier to protect the power system from lightning, and maintaining its good thermal stability is of great significance for its safe operation. In this paper, the model of lightning arrester is established by finite element, the simulation calculation of the electrical-thermal characteristics under the impact of lightning current and large current is studied, the heating and heat dissipation characteristics of the arrester under different conditions are obtained, and the arrester is found in different environments Maximum operating temperature at temperature. And through the joint pressurization test, the temperature of the resistor sheet when the arrester thermally collapses under actual conditions is found, and the test results are in agreement with the simulation results. The research results show that if the zinc oxide resistor has a large amount of heat, poor heat dissipation from the resistor, and uneven electric field distribution, the arrester will reach the limit operating temperature. When the limit temperature is exceeded, the arrester will soon fall into thermal collapse and thermal fusion will occur. Wear, crack, and explode. Therefore, effective measures must be taken to improve the thermal stability of zinc oxide surge arresters.

articleTitle: An artificial intelligence adjustment method of large-scale power flow based on knowledge-driven
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With China's power grid gradually showing the characteristics of long distance, heavy load, large-area interconnection, and introduction of market competition, the situation that power flow calculation does not converge appears more and more frequently. Therefore, solving the problem of power flow non-convergence will become the focus and difficulty of power flow calculation. At present, analysis and calculation personnel often can only make adjustments based on experience. This traditional adjustment method is inefficient, which has high work intensity, and the effects is also not obvious. This paper proposes a artificial intelligence adjustment method of large-scale power flow based on knowledge-driven. This method expresses the knowledge and experience accumulated in power flow adjustment process in the form of knowledge graph, and builds knowledge base on this basis. And then, this paper takes the knowledge base rules as the criterion of power flow intelligent adjustment, which can provides the reasoning and deduction of logical and possible about the adjustment direction and adjustment measures So as to make correct judgments and decisions. Finally this paper realizes the artificial intelligence adjustment of the large-scale power flow.

articleTitle: Dispatch of Multi-Energy Systems with District Heating Network Considering the Renewable Power Generation Uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The electrification of the heating system and transport sector facilitates the process of the multi-energy system integration, with the technologies of electric vehicles and district heating. In this paper, a multi-energy system consisting of renewable energy generation, electric vehicles, heat storages, electric heat pumps, energy storage, is presented and modeled to maximize its economic and environmental benefits. The uncertainty in the renewable generation is incorporated utilizing the K-means clustering method to generate representative scenarios, whilst the heat demand is simulated with the day-ahead outdoor temperature forecast. The dispatch of the system under a flexible price signal is modeled to minimize the energy costs and carbon dioxide emissions along with several cases utilized to test the applicability of the proposed model. Numerical results confirm the effectiveness of the proposed model, as the system energy cost from grid importation as well as the peak net demand decrease compared with no energy storage.

articleTitle: Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring Based on Data Correlation for Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Non-intrusive load monitoring (NILM) has significant supporting effect on demand response. However, the mini-watt equipment, continuous operation equipment and variable state equipment have brought great difficulties to the identification accuracy. This paper proposes a method to identify load components based on the data correlation. This method is constructed via three steps: first, a physical electrical constraints model is applied to abstract the relationship between load customers and distribution network; second, a stepwise method with cross validation is used to select the most relevant features; and third, the load components are explained by the characteristics model and solved by combinatorial optimization method. Finally, the accuracy of the proposed algorithm is verified by comparison against the NILMTK algorithms through detailed simulations over high frequency engineering data.

articleTitle: Classification of Customer Service Tickets in Power System Based on Character and Word Level Semantic Understanding
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Recently, a large amount of electric power data has been accumulated in the power system because of the development of information technology. Customer service ticket data is one of the most important types of electric power data. Classifying customer service tickets according to the text content is conducive to understanding customer demands accurately. So it is of great significance to improve the quality and efficiency of power system operation. In this paper, we propose a classification model of power system customer service tickets based on hierarchical semantic understanding. The deep learning method is used to simultaneously model the words and characters in the tickets. And then the hierarchical semantic representations can be used to classify tickets. The contrast experiments on real dataset prove that the proposed method can accurately learn the hidden semantics of tickets, and has better classification accuracy than the comparative approaches.

articleTitle: A 110kV transformer breakdown resulting from insufficient short circuit resistance
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The short-circuit resistance is an important performance indicator of operating transformers. It is affected by so many factors like product quality, operating condition, and maintenance. This paper provides a short circuit fault in a 110kV transformer and drowns some conclusion of evaluating and maintaining short-circuit resistance during lifetime of transformers. This is of great importance for preventing transformer short-circuit damage and good help for making suggestions to improve reliability of the power grid.

articleTitle: The Stability Analysis of a Class of Electric Power Network Model
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The stability of equilibrium point is an essential problem to be considered in the study of power network system, a small fault in the system may lead to collapse of the power grid. This paper makes a detailed theoretical supplement to the stability analysis of the equilibrium point of the power network model proposed by Yang and Motter. We introduce noise and time delay that may exist in actual power network system, and study the stability of the equilibrium point of the power network model with noise and time delay. Besides, this paper improves the transmission line model of the power network model to make it closer to modern intelligent grid. Finally, a numerical simulation of a 7-bus power network system is carried out to further verify the stability of the equilibrium point of the power network with time delay and noise in this paper.

articleTitle: Data Monitoring Technology for Testing Process of New Generation Dispatching and Control System
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Application function of new generation dispatching and control system needs to be tested before online running. A functional testing environment for new generation of control system is constructed. The data monitoring and performance monitoring software of the testing process is deployed on the simulation server, the new generation monitoring system, and the new generation analysis decision center. Multi-source data information are aggregated and analyzed to comprehensively monitor the testing data, testing processes and indicators, so that the application of dispatching and control system can be evaluated more objectively.

articleTitle: Research on Low Voltage Control Measures of distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: distribution network voltage is the main index of power quality, which has a direct impact on the safety and stability of distribution network and the safe operation of power equipment, power loss of transmission lines, industrial and agricultural safety production and people's daily electricity consumption. Based on the PSASP simulation software, the real-time simulation analysis of the voltage in the Nailin area is carried out. During the irrigation period, the simulation results show that the low voltage problem is serious, and the daily load fluctuation is obvious, so it is necessary to adopt the control measures which can adjust the voltage in both directions flexibly. After comparison, the line voltage regulator and SVG are proposed to be used. After low voltage control, the simulation results show that the low voltage problem is obviously improved . Finally, the management measures to improve the low voltage problem are put forward.

articleTitle: Research on distributed FA adaptive technology for abnormal 4G wireless communication
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Firstly, this paper studies the possibility of 4G wireless communication technology in the distributed feeder automation (FA) of distribution network. Through the research of wireless communication characteristics, aiming at the problems of communication delay, communication packet loss and communication multi packet, the communication quality control mechanism and the duplicate name message discarding mechanism are adopted to deal with them respectively. According to the abnormal situation of 4G wireless communication, this paper puts forward the research on distributed FA adaptive technology of distribution network to solve the demand of high power supply reliability in intelligent city.

articleTitle: A Practical Strategy for Three-phase Unbalance in distribution network Area Based on Multi-Dimensional Atlas
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to improve the relevance of the three-phase unbalance treatment in the distribution network area, this paper applies the map analysis tool to the daily monitoring work of the distribution network area repair, using historical data cleaning to extract the feature values, and pinpoint the shortcomings of the three-phase unbalance situation in the distribution network area According to different three-phase unbalance, different cooperative elimination strategies are adopted. The graph analysis tool specifically selects the method of extracting feature values to visualize the data. Taking the real data of the system as an example, it can be realized by using computer language programming, and the output results are correct and targeted. The three-phase unbalanced practical strategy based on multi-dimensional maps proposed in this paper can reduce the labor cost and time cost of the monitoring work in the distribution network area, improve the operation reliability of the distribution area and the display effect of the service platform.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Method for Prepayment Electricity Customer Selection
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The State Grid Corporation of China is promoting the prepayment business. Selecting prepayment customers in batches helps smooth transition of the billing methods and acceleration of electricity charge recovery. So, an intelligent method is proposed for prepayment customer selection.Firstly, an index set and further a decision tree method is presented for identifying leasing and seasonal electricity consumption behaviors. Secondly, features of malicious arrears are extracted and the multi-class support vector machine method is used to identify malicious arrears. By integrating customers’ characteristics in electricity consumption and payment, an entropy-weighted analytical hierarchy process is finally conducted to evaluate the customers’ priorities of prepayment implementation.A case study towards 3850 residents in 6 communities of Shanghai shows that the proposed method can accurately identify the leasing and seasonal consumption behaviors, the sign intention for prepayment contracts of the selected customers is 11.76 times larger than that of the randomly selected ones, and the total arrear in electricity charge of the screened first batch is 6.51 times higher than that of the randomly selected group.

articleTitle: Research on the Unqualified Quality of Cable Materials in Distribution Network and the Control Measures
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As an important way for power distribution, the distribution network based on various types of wire and cable products is directly related to the safety of power transportation. Based on the 2331 test results of extruded insulated power cables and overhead insulated wires of the testing center in recent years, this paper analyzes and studies the change of the unqualified rate and the possible causes and hazards of unqualified products. The study found that the unqualified items of the distribution network wire and cable products mainly focused on the structural size, insulation thermal shrinkage, thermal extension and 20 °C conductor direct- current resistance. Further investigation shows that the factors that lead to the quality failure of the distribution network wire and cable products can be basically attributed to two aspects: one is the raw material problem, some manufacturers use substandard insulation materials and conductor materials when producing cables; the second is the processing technology problem, steel tape winding process, insulation cross-linking process and conductor drawing process is not under strict control. Based on the above research, this work puts forward measures to improve the quality of distribution network wire and cable products, hoping to attract manufacturers' attention to product quality and provide analytical support for the quality control of distribution network materials.

articleTitle: The Study of Mobile Browsing for Power Flow Diagram in Power System
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The research and application of power system security protection technology has promoted the rapid development of mobile applications of power grid companies. In order to ensure the safe data interaction between internal and external networks, this paper proposes an information security transmission technology, which comprehensively adopts the important information transmission system of attack protection measures, special security access gateway, security isolation and other technologies and applies it in practice. A data processing technology for mobile applications is proposed. The mobile browsing function of tide chart is developed. Provides the possibility to view trend maps in the non‐workplace during non‐office hours and during special periods; Improved the ability of relevant management and technical personnel to control the operation state of the power grid to support the operation management of the power grid and the fast resumption of power supply.

articleTitle: Application of Spatial Four-dimensional Scattering Management Technology in Substation Concealed Engineering Acceptance
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposes a concealed engineering acceptance based on building model information and internet of things technology, namely spatial four-dimensional scattering management technology, to realize the digital control of engineering construction process. Through the application in the construction process of the new Kaixuan 110kV substation, it is explored how to improve the acceptance quality and efficiency of concealed projects.

Author Keywords: the spatial four-dimensional scattering management technology

articleTitle: Analysis on the malfunction of zero sequence protection in 35kV ungrounded system of wind farm
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Due to the wind farm 35kV system single-phase grounding fault capacitance current is relatively large, Therefore, the wind farm 35kV system adopts the bus configuration Z-type grounding transformer and the neutral point is grounded by small resistance, Zero sequence protection are used to quickly remove the single phase ground fault.In this paper, the single-phase ground fault of wind power plant collection wire in Eastern Inner Mongoliais is taken as an example. introduces the working principle of zero sequence current transformer,Clarify the setting and matching principles of zero sequence protection,,Comparing the different wiring modes of several cable shielding layers will be cause how Influence on the secondary measurement current of zero-sequence transformer, Analyze the zero sequence protection rejection of the set wire,The cause of the grounding tripping event. Summarizes the cable shield connection mode correctly,And propose rectification measures on site.

articleTitle: Comprehensive evaluation of reliability life and economy of electric energy meter considering intermittent operation mode
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the application process of smart electric energy meter, not all components are in working state all the time. According to the working stress to predict its reliability index will lead to the conservatism of the predicted results. Therefore, it is necessary to consider the non-stress state of the intermittent mode unit, so as to make a more reasonable and accurate prediction. In this paper, a reliability prediction method considering non-stress state of components in intermittent operation mode is proposed, and a practical reliability prediction model of electric energy meter is established, which realizes the accurate reliability prediction of intelligent electric energy meter in intermittent mode. Based on the theory of reliability prediction and life cycle cost of electric energy meter, a comprehensive evaluation model of reliability and economy of smart electric energy meter is established, which provides a theoretical basis for the formulation of reliability index and related management policies of smart electric energy meter.

articleTitle: Power Ancillary Service Option - LP Turbine Outage Scheme, its Peaking Load Performance and Cost
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As one of the modification options to enhance the peaking load regulating capability of existing cogeneration units, LP turbine outage upgrading scheme has been adopted increasingly in the past few years, yet many of the studies focused on the operation safety of the LP turbine outage scheme, its’ influence on increasing of the heating capacity and unit economic performance indexes. Here the full influence of this upgrading scheme on peak load regulating capability and economic benefit of the unit are addressed. The performance of one typical 300MW cogeneration unit adopting the specified scheme is studied based on the model simulation of the EBSILON software. The results indicate that minimum peaking load of the modified unit decreases with the decreasing of the heating load, and the peaking power loss under upgrading operation mode is basically unchanged when the heating load changes, which is maintained at about 51MW. Significant unit operational economic benefit loss is paralleled with the peaking power loss, and the calculated compensation standard or cost for peaking power loss is within the range of 0.14~0.15 Yuan/kWh. This study provides an overview picture of the specified upgrading scheme, including the peak load regulating capability improvement and the relevant operational economic benefit loss incurred, which is very critical for the decision making of the scheme. The calculated compensation standard or cost for peaking power loss can be regarded as a baseline for plant owners to make competitive bidding in the power ancillary service markets.

articleTitle: Analysis of short circuit current of transformers in both mechanical and thermal ways
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: When short circuit fault happened to a transformer, which current was current several times than the rated current, it would produce mechanical and thermal effect in the transformer winding. When the short-circuit resistance of the transformer was not enough, it may lead to axial or radial deformation of winding, weakening of winding strength, decreasing of insulation performance and other problems. Therefore, it is necessary to make a comprehensive analysis of mechanical and thermal effect in order to judge the overall state of the transformer after short circuit fault and ensure the safety and reliability of power grid.

articleTitle: Users-transformer relationship identification based on smart meter data
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In electric power utilities, the record of users and transformers will not update the related information on time after the connection changes due to the load balance requirements or other reasons. Manual information correction not only takes time but also requires special equipment. The paper shows the innovative method and practice in the electric power utilities of the users-transformers relationship detection. In the first step, the method extracts the high-frequency features from the current time series data by wavelet transform. Then, a mathematics model which reveals the relationship between users and transformers is created based on the Kirchhoff’s law of current. At last, the result can be achieved by solving the model with mixed integer linear programming (MILP) with participation of Groubi optimizer. The paper also shows the structure and display panel of the secondary power distribution system smart management platform. The proposed method can identify the relationship between users and transformers with smart meter data and the smart management platform helps the electric power utility staff make secondary power distribution system management better.

articleTitle: Construction of Intelligent Evaluation Model of Power Informatization Monitoring Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The traditional intelligent evaluation model of power informatization monitoring platform has the defect of large evaluation error. Therefore, the intelligent evaluation model of electric power information monitoring platform is researched. The neural network is adopted for processing of the electric power information monitoring platform data to obtain the data characteristics. %ased on the characteristics, the intelligent evaluation network of electric power information monitoring platform is constructed to establish the intelligent evaluation model of electric power information monitoring platform. The constructed intelligent evaluation model of electric power information monitoring platform is adopted for the intelligent evaluation of electric power information monitoring platform. The e[periment shows that the evaluation error of the intelligent evaluation model of established electric power information monitoring platform is 2 less than that of the traditional model, which sufficiently describes that the intelligent evaluation model of established electric power information monitoring platform owns better evaluation performance.

articleTitle: The power supply unit division of the medium voltage distribution network considering the complementary of the load characteristics
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The method of dividing the power supply unit considering the complementary of the load characteristic is presented to solve the problems of the large size of the network and low equipment utilization ratio caused by the lack of consideration of complementation of load characteristic in distribution network planning. First, based on the existing research results on load clustering and grid planning, the concepts of the feeder block and the power supply unit are redefined and the technical framework of MV distribution network planning considering the division of the power supply is designed. Then, the evaluation indexes of feeder block division considering the complementary of the load characteristic are set up, and rotation center line distance weighting alternate location algorithm is proposed to divide the feeder block. Further, the evaluation indexes of feeder block division considering complementary of the load characteristic are set up, and the method of dividing the power supply unit is proposed. Finally, the scientificalness and practicability of the model and method in this paper was verified through the case study.

articleTitle: Temporal GIS Key Technology and Application of Large-Scale Distribution Network Based on The base state with amendment model
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the rapid growth and development of the distribution network, how to manage and display the development and change of the distribution network becomes more and more important. A temporal GIS design method, practical system and its application of a large-scale distribution network based on the base state with amendment model are presented in this paper. First, the background and needs of the power GIS temporal model are analyzed. Second, the construction principle of the power temporal GIS based on the base state with amendment model is illustrated. The power grid model is divided into several continuous state sections according to the changes of the time axis. In each state section, the graphs, topologies and attributes of the changed power grid model in the section are recorded in increments. Finally, typical application scenarios of the actual system in the distribution network planning and operation business of Yunnan Province are introduced, which can help to realize full life cycle management of the power grid model.

Author Keywords: the base state with amendment model

articleTitle: Research on Access Solution of Communication Network for Smart Home Energy Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper describes the communication technology used in the smart home energy monitoring system from two aspects. On the one hand, users can realize two-way interaction of electricity through the company communication network; On the other hand, the real-time monitoring of smart home can be realized through the telecom operator network and the home domain ZigBee network. This paper focuses on the technical characteristics of ZigBee and networking application of Internet of things in home domain.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influence of Anti-Corrosive Coating on the Heat Dissipation of Distribution Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: When the distribution transformer works, the loss formed in the winding and iron core will spread to the surrounding air after the transmission of transformer oil and transformer tank, and cause temperature rising. With the growth of power demand, the overheating problem of distribution transformer becomes worse and worse, which reduces operation economy and brings potential safety hazard. In this paper, the transformer tank is subdivided into a composite structure of metal material and anti-corrosive coating material. Starting from the heat transmission process of transformer, the influence of anti-corrosive coating on the heat dissipation of distribution transformer is analyzed in detail. By experiments the effect of high thermal conductivity anti-corrosive coating on the heat dissipation efficiency of distribution transformer is verified. The conclusion shows that improving the heat transfer performance of anti-corrosive coating material will effectively improve the overall heat dissipation efficiency of distribution transformer. It will provide a new idea to study the temperature rise of distribution transformer.

articleTitle: Fitting and simulation of characteristic curve of micro gas turbine compressor
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Microturbine is widely used in distributed power generation systems and is the core energy exchange equipment of integrated energy systems. Among them, the characteristic curve of the compressor is very important in the establishment of the simulation model of the Microturbine. However, under variable working conditions, the physical process inside the compressor is complex, and currently there is no accurate theoretical formula to describe the characteristic curve of the compressor. In this paper, the characteristic curve of the compressor was obtained by using the equation fitted according to the existing data and combining with the interpolation method, and the simulation model of the Microturbine was established based on MATLAB/Simulink to analyze the characteristics of the compressor. The simulation results showed the accuracy of the fitting curve obtained by this method.

articleTitle: Stochastic power fluctuations analysis on relationship between the tie-line of interconnected power systems and bus power injection
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The power fluctuation characteristics of tieline are analyzed in this paper. Based on two area system DC load flow model derivation is carried out. In the time domain, there is a weighted linear relationship between power fluctuation of tie-line and different power fluctuation source's power injection; in the frequency domain, the self-PSD of tie-line power fluctuation can be expressed as the weighted linear sum of the self-PSD and cross-PSD of different power fluctuation source's power injection. Under certain conditions, the self-PSD of tie-line power fluctuation can be expressed via some simplified formula. The relationship deduced before is verified further in simulation of practical grid example.

articleTitle: Application of Transformer Condition Maintenance Based On Multi-dimensional Parameter On-line Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper introduces the application of multi-dimensional state parameter monitoring and fault diagnosis system in transformer state maintenance. It mainly solves the problem of how to improve the level of condition monitoring, evaluation and maintenance. The system integrates the multi-dimensional state monitoring methods of capacitive equipment such as leakage current, partial discharge, oil chromatography and vibration signal. Through a successful case of 500 kV main transformer operation condition monitoring, evaluation, diagnosis and maintenance, this paper describes how to realize the functions of insulation condition monitoring, evaluation, diagnosis and auxiliary maintenance of power network equipment in order to eliminate equipment faults and avoid major power failure. Therefore, the application of the system in smart city can effectively improve the monitoring and maintenance level of power grid equipment and the reliability of Power Grid, and provide support for big data analysis of Smart City Power Grid.

articleTitle: Optimization of Design on Image Surveillance System in Distribution Stations Based on Cost over Life Cycle
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Distribution stations are the pivots for distribution system in urban areas, which spread massively, cover large areas and are hard to manage. The disposition of image surveillance system for environment and equipment in distribution stations largely enhances unmanned management. However, overly or deficiently configuration of image surveillance system and unnecessarily or insufficiently disposition of image surveillance system equipment are violations for quality improvement and efficiency enhancement. Based on lowering cost over life cycle, this paper proposes an optimization model for design of image surveillance system. Considered from investment cost of surveillance equipment, operation and maintenance cost and loss on power failure, proposed model builds an objective function on the view of life cycle and provides an optimal solution for the design of image surveillance system, which is subject to geometric attributions of distribution stations, layouts of switchgear and surveillance areas. Case study indicates the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Failure Analysis of a 110 kV Composite Insulator with High Voltage Sheath Cracking
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, the crack cause of a 110 kV composite insulator sheath was investigated by means of several different test methods. The results indicated that the crack of the HV sheath was mainly related to the unqualified bonding process and long-term external stress actions. Air void was introduced into the metal fitting-sheath interface due to inferior pasting technology, causing accelerated aging of HV sheath silicone rubber materials. Besides, the corner of composite insulator sheath was always high stress concentrated. Finally, long-term external stress actions and heat inducing accelerated aging of silicone rubber materials resulted in the HV sheath cracking.

articleTitle: Optimal dispatch of multi-energy complementary integrated energy systems
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Integrated energy system is an effective way to realize multi-energy complementation in intelligent parks, but its system operation and scheduling is difficult to balance economy and environmental protection. For the optimization of the operation and control of the combined cooling, heating and power supply system, a comprehensive energy system has been established, including photovoltaic, wind power, gas turbines, chillers, waste heat and power. The economic dispatch optimization model for renewable energy sources such as recovery systems and energy storage devices, with the goal of minimizing economic operating costs, and comprehensive The fuel cost, power purchase and sale cost, carbon emission cost, etc. are considered and solved by the model prediction and control method. Finally, the actual smart park energy system is simulated and analyzed to verify the validity and feasibility of the established model, and the results show that based on the optimization method of model prediction and control can optimize the overall operating costs of the system and provide a preliminary stage for the planning of the integrated energy system of the park.

articleTitle: Electric Equipment Panel Detection and Segmentation based on Mask R-CNN
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposed a method for detecting the panel of equipment in the power room based on deep learning technology. For a real-time image, we can achieve the purpose of equipment panel detection and segmentation, which facilitate the task of equipment monitoring. We use the Mask R-CNN algorithm to detect how many target devices there are in the picture and to find the category corresponding to each device. In each target device, the foreground and background are distinguished at the pixel level. The method is described as follows. First of all, we collected a total of 4,500 pictures in 60 categories of power room equipment for our experiments. Next, we labeled all the pictures using Labelimg, which is an open source software for data annotation, the marked pictures were preprocessed as the data set to train and test the proposed model. The well performance on the test set shows that our proposed method has a certain implementability and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Research on Assisted Strategy of Fault Line Selecting Method for Single-phase Ground Fault in Distribution Netword Base on Automation System
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to effectively improve the working efficiency of dispatchers using the ‘pull test method’ for single-phase ground fault line selection, this paper presents avariety of steady-state electrical quantities such as voltage, current, and reactive power obtained based on the distribution automation system, and combined with the line topology to generate fault line selection auxiliary strategies for different grounding systems that based on the superposition of multi-dimensional elements. Explained the technical principle of identifying the nature and phase of ground faults. Analyzed and introduced the organic fusion technology of fault features in multiple dimensions such as zero-sequence current amplitude, zero-sequence current mutation, reactive power mutation, etc. for different grounding methods and arc suppression coil compensation modes. Than formed "pull test"sequence of all lines. The proposed method does not require the addition of special hardware equipment or the transformation of the neutral point of the substation, not only saves investment, but also effectively reduces the number of line test pulls, and realizes rapid identification and accurate line selection of single-phase ground faults. The feasibility and applicability of this method were demonstrated in combination with specific projects.

Author Keywords: fault line selecting method for single-phase ground fault

articleTitle: An Improved WAMS Framework for Multi-modal Oscillation Detection in a Power Electronics Dominated Power System
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In power electronics dominated power systems, the multi-modal oscillation becomes one of the culprits that threaten the system stability. However, the existing wide-area measurement system (WAMS) focusing on single-modal oscillation such as low-frequency oscillation. It fails in meeting the requirements of multi-modal oscillation monitoring due to the adoption of conventional phasor measurement units (PMUs). Therefore, in this paper, an improved WAMS framework is proposed. The modifications include the deployment of wide-band phasor monitoring units (WPMUs) at several vital nodes to detect oscillation dynamically and trigger the wave-recording function of traditional PMUs simultaneously when oscillation is detected. The synchronized multi-modal phasor data captured by WPMUs, together with the recorded wave data, will be transmitted to the master station for real-time oscillation analyzing. While meeting the requirements of wide-band oscillation monitoring, the proposed framework can be compatible with the existing hardware and communication architecture to the greatest extent without affecting the operation of the present WAMS system. The practice of the proposed WAMS framework on a realistic regional power grid has validated the feasibility, the backward compatibility, and the multi-modal oscillation detection capability.

articleTitle: The research on the layout mode of the main network and the secondary network of the diamond distribution network
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of the lack of the research on the coordinated layout mode of the switch station and the ring station in the development of the diamond distribution network proposed in the Shanghai area, it constructed the Shanghai diamond distribution network collaborative layout mode of the main and the secondary network. Firstly, it introduced the wiring mode of the diamond distribution network, and equivalented the power supply range of the substation into a regular hexagon, and established the diamond-shaped power supply model of the diamond distribution network, and analyzed the factors in the layout mode of the main and the secondary network in the diamond distribution network; Secondly, it constructed the layout model of the main network in the diamond distribution network considering the combination of reliability and economy;Finally, within the power supply range of the switch station,it constructed the layout model of the secondary network in the diamond distribution network considering the combination of reliability and economy. In the end, the best layout model of the main and secondary main network of the diamond distribution network was obtained, which provided the quantitative support for the planning of the diamond distribution network in Shanghai, and gived the guiding significance.

articleTitle: The Research for the Verification Mechanism of the Medium and Long-term Electricity Transactions Based on Operation Flow and Data Chain
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: After China started a new round of power system reform, the medium and long-term electricity transaction has been steadily promoted in all provinces and made positive progress. In September 2019, the State Energy Administration of China pointed out that there are still some problems in the construction and operation of the electricity market in its opinion on strengthening the supervision of medium and long-term electricity transaction, such as imperfect trading mechanism, inadequate implementation of trading rules, and irregular trading organization. At present, the research on medium and long-term transaction is mainly focused on transaction strategy, transaction security analysis, deviation handling mechanism, etc. How to ensure the fairness of transaction organization, the validity of transaction data, the accuracy and timeliness of transaction results, which needs further research . so that the market subjects can make clear transactions, and further improve the credibility of the power transaction center in the market subjects. Based on the operation flow and transaction data chain of the medium and long-term electricity transactions, this paper proposes a whole life cycle verification scheme and system of the medium and long-term electricity transactions for Monitoring and verification for the medium and long term transactions with comprehensive consideration of Yunnan electricity market transaction access, transaction declaration, security check and transaction clearing rules.Firstly, it is to establish a monitoring system to control, remind and correct all aspects of the power medium and long-term transaction business process.At the same time, with the help of transaction calendar, it can realize automatic control and real-time process display for each link of transaction organization, effectively reduce transaction organization errors and avoid missing transaction time. Secondly,it is to establish a transaction business data verification mechanism and system,which covers the whole life cycle of the trading process, so as to reduce the data errors of different transaction organization links, remind and correct them,which can ensure the validity and practicability of the transaction data .Thirdly,it is to establish multi-dimensional check relationships of the medium and long-term electricity transaction data chain,which can verify the correctness and rationality of transaction data.For example, declaration of electricity quantity, security correction of electricity quantity, transaction electricity quantity and other transaction information, which can establish a reasonable checking relationship of transaction electricity quantity, The three aspects above shall be coordinated ,which can build a strict verification network for the medium and long-term electricity transactions.Since the operation of Yunnan electric power market, the trading rules have been matured gradually, the trading quantity has increased in a high proportion, the trading price has been stable.The power exchange of Kunming has got a high score of the third-party satisfaction check every year, which has been affirmed and recognized by the majority of market participants.The practice in Yunnan electric market proves that the medium and long-term transaction verification scheme and system is effective.which can ensure the standardization and fairness of the medium and long-term electricity transaction organization and be good forguaranteeing the accuracy and practicability of transaction results, reducing the transaction risks for market subjects.Furthermore,the medium and long-term transaction verification scheme and system is good for the smooth and orderly operation of electric power medium and long-term market.

Author Keywords: The medium and long-term electricity transactions

articleTitle: An active power reserve capacity optimal configuration method for power grid subareas considering reliability
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Ensure system reliability and economy. Aiming at the characteristics of power grids such as UHVDC access, distributed new energy penetration, and differentiated load characteristics in the existing power grid, a method for optimizing the configuration of the reserve capacity between subareas of a regional power considering reliability is proposed. Based on the constraints of frequency regulation performance requirements under the accident conditions of each subarea and the grid regulation requirements under non-accident conditions and reliability index of subarea this optimal configuration model for subarea reserve capacity is established with the minimum total reserve capacity of the entire power grid as the optimization objective. Considering the mathematical characteristics of the model, a solution method of ‘linear programming and iterative optimization’ is proposed. This method is conducive to reducing the total reserve capacity of the system and improving the overall operation reliability and economy of the power grid on the basis of guaranteeing the regulation and control performance and reliability requirements of each subarea of the power grid.

articleTitle: Active Distribution Network Reconfiguration Based on Prim Algorithm and Chaos Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: According to the character of active distribution network that it could actively control and manage distributed energy resources, this paper puts forward a distribution network reconfiguration method for active distribution network. Because of the random power of distributed generation driven by renewable energy, this paper regards power of controllable load and electrical energy storage as controllable value and takes the effect of V2G(Vehicle-to-grid)into consideration, thus establishes a multi-objective optimization model. Based on knowledge of Graph Theory, this paper proposes a reconfiguration strategy containing island partition, and uses a hybrid algorithm of Prim algorithm and chaos particle swarm optimization to solve the model and optimize reconfiguration project. The validity of the proposed method of active distribution network reconfiguration is verified by simulation results of IEEE 33-node distribution system.

articleTitle: A Real-time Reporting Solution for LV Power Supply Interruption
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: For real-time reporting of power supply interruption on LV users, there essentially need the availabilities of both the back-up supply for communication module in smart meter and the communication channel between smart meter and main station. This paper studies a real-time reporting solution which embeds super capacitor as the back-up supply of communication module in smart meter and uses micro-power communication scheme for LV users. Field tests of 30 LV distribution areas in Baoji Power Supply Branch verifies the proposed solution. The application prospects of the proposed solution are further discussed, such as interruption diagnosis and fault analysis, under urban and rural LV scenarios.

Author Keywords: real-time reporting of power supply interruption

articleTitle: Cluster Synchronization of Kuramoto Oscillators Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The increasing demand for power makes the synchronization or cluster synchronization of power grid become an essential topic. In this paper, from the view of complex network, the following work is accomplished based on Kuramoto oscillators network: (1) Theoretically prove the condition of frequency cluster synchronization of Kuramoto oscillators network. (2) Using the method of Lagrange multiplier, propose an algorithm to modify the adjacency matrix, which makes a large class of Kuramoto oscillator network reach frequency cluster synchronization after modification. The correctness of the algorithm is verified by numerical simulation. (3) Analyze the stability of the algorithm in (2), we find that the reduction of the number of adjustable adjacency weights will reduce the stability of the algorithm. Besides, the initial value of each oscillator also affects.

articleTitle: The Key Technologies and Applications of Cable Corridor Resource Management and Monitoring Based on GIS and IoT
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: According to the data analysis of breakdowns and repairs, the problems including high failure rate, long repair time, and high cost of repair and power failure of distribution network cable have been found. To solve the problems and strengthen the monitoring and management of underground cable corridors, a cable corridor resource management and monitoring system based on GIS and IoT was proposed in this paper. Firstly, the current status of large cable corridor equipment, imperfect basic data management, and high failure rate were analyzed through historical statistical data. Second, the overall architecture of the cable corridor resource management and monitoring system was described. And the key technologies including the corridor resource management based on GIS, underground path identification based on RFID, cable and environmental monitoring based on IoT, on-site operation management and control based on App, etc. were presented. Finally, the application results of the system construction were summarized.

articleTitle: Influence of matching size of detachable connector and bushing on insulation performance
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, two-dimensional axisymmetric modeling is used to simulate the electric field distribution of separable connector and bushing under different matching sizes, and the reasonable structural optimization design scheme and installation fit size are given. The size and position of the internal shielding of the bushing have different effects on the electric field distribution after assembly. By studying the typical structures of several separable connectors and bushings for 12kV switchgear, the electric field under different matching sizes and shielding modes is simulated and analyzed. On this basis, the discharge probability coefficient α is introduced to judge the position where the discharge occurs first. The results show that: for the structure optimization of the detachable connector and the bushing, the shielding position of the two affects the electric field distribution. The metal mesh is embedded in the epoxy resin as a shield, and the distance between the end of the shielding net and the taper end of the sleeve is reduced, the step size of the detachable connector matched with the bushing is increased, and separable connectors are shielded by step part all semiconductor. It can play the role of uniform electric field.

articleTitle: Difference study on European and American standards for separable connector
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: At present most of the cable terminals used in the fully enclosed gas-filled ring cabinet are separable connectors. In this paper, firstly the European standard EN50181 and the IEEE Std 386TM-2016 standard adopted by American enterprises were systematically analyzed and compared, then technical differences of separable connectors under different standard constraints was studied. The effect of the size and position of the internal shielding of the bushing on the electric field distribution have been simulated. The research is helpful to put forward the inspection and maintenance specifications of separable connectors that meet the requirements of inflatable cabinets in China.

articleTitle: Meteorological Analysis of Icing and Galloping of Transmission Lines in Tianjin around Bohai Sea
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper shown meteorological analysis of icing and galloping of transmission lines in Tianjin around Bohai Sea. Tianjin experienced a wide range of rain, snow and freezing weather. Affected by the cold wave and blizzard, the line dance trip occurred in some areas of Tianjin (including the dual power supply of Sinopec Tianjin LNG). The main time period of the fault is mainly distributed in the coastal areas of southeast Tianjin, involving Binhai, Dongli, and Jinnan. Based on the actual situation in Tianjin, we analyze the weather process, dancing conditions, equipment failures, and exposure issues respectively. It includes icing and galloping’s weather process analysis, analysis of galloping, equipment fault analysis and analysis of dancing characteristics.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Power Supply Path Trace in Integrated Dispatching/Distribution Automation System
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposes a method of power supply path trace suitable for integrated dispatching/distribution automation system. It can realize the target device’s trace function of superior power supplies, its retrieval scope can extend to 220kV high voltage looped network, and the highest voltage level it can reach is up to 500kV. The power supply path presents directly as automatical mapping, which can reflect the power supply safety, trace process and trace result dynamically. This paper demonstrates the basic principle of the function realization, provides technical researches of power supply path tracing and automatical mapping based on integration modeling technology of dispatch. It can follow the full power supply path and observability of power supplies with higher voltage levels. The correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by different functional scenario analysis and application examples.

articleTitle: A fault prediction method of distribution network based on the improved RelieF-Softmax algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A fault risk prediction method for distribution network based on improved RelieF-Softmax algorithm is proposed. Firstly, the fault data of distribution network is obtained and 14 fault characteristics are extracted through data investigation. The improved relief filtering feature extraction method is adopted to screen the initial fault feature set and select key fault features. Finally, a distribution network fault warning method based on the cross entropy loss function of focal loss is proposed, and the results of calculation examples demonstrate the effectiveness of the method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Multi-criteria fusion verification method of CVT harmonic measurement error in operation
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the continued deepening of power quality monitoring and management, the harmonic measurement error caused by the capacitor voltage transformer (CVT), which is widely used in the high-voltage power grid, can not be avoided. Firstly, the root cause of CVT harmonic measurement error is studied by the harmonic equivalent model, and constructs a high-voltage intelligent test platform covering multi-voltage level CVT harmonic measurement error, and carries out a number of in-depth measurement tests to compare and analyze the difference of different CVT harmonic measurement errors. Secondly, based on the test results, a multi-criteria fusion method is proposed to verify the CVT harmonic measurement error in substation field operation. Finally, the monitoring scheme of a 220kV substation is designed accordingly. The analysis results show that the method can effectively judge the CVT harmonic measurement error.

articleTitle: Research on Pricing and Clearing Mechanism of Provincial Regulation Market and Analysis of Examples
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Reasonable design of pricing and clearing mechanism of regulation service has a great influence on improving regulation performance of units, improving regulation service quality, promoting the optimal allocation of regulation resources. In order to further stimulate units to improve regulation performance, gradually attract high-quality regulation resources and optimize the allocation of regulation resources, typical province in East China has designed and ran a regulation service market. This paper analyzes the pricing, clearing mechanism and settlement price of regulation market in typical province of East China. From the perspective of the cost of regulation resources, the basis of regulation mileage and capacity bid is analyzed, Based on the principle of regulation order processing, the mathematical model to evaluate and measure the regulation performance score is derived, the adjustment of regulation bid and clearing mechanism based on the regulation performance are discussed, and explains the clearing mechanism of the hour-ahead regulation market and the pricing and settlement mechanism of the real-time FM market. Through the optimization algorithm, the opportunity cost calculation formula and its simplified model is provided. Finally, the effect of the pricing mechanism in improving the regulation performance is verified through the case analysis of the typical province.

articleTitle: PM2.5 prevention and control strategy and analysis of clean energy utilization
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the economy developing, the environment problems, especially about air quality, have been a hit problem. In the PM2.5 source analysis, coal combustion is one of the important factors in the formation of PM2.5 local source. In this paper, we build network model with PM2.5 data of 366 cities in China from January 2015 to June 2017. Specifically, we construct a symmetric correlation network by partial correlation coefficient and an asymmetric information transportation network by transfer entropy. Then the spatial and temporal characteristics of PM2.5 are studied through time-variant complex networks. Structural control theory of complex networks helps to find the control node sets, which provide suggestions to prevent PM2.5 pollution. Further, we analyze the national power data and the correlation analysis shows the clean energy ratio and PM2.5 concentration are strongly correlated. Finally, control strategy of clean energy for PM2.5 is provided.

articleTitle: Analysis of multi-stage active distribution network planning based on golden section Fibonacci tree optimization method
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Due to without considering the reliability of intermittent distribution power, and network load distribution is unreasonable. The planning effect of traditional active distribution network planning method is not ideal. Based on this, this paper proposed a multi-stage active distribution network planning model. On the basis of conventional load forecasting, the intermittent distribution power supply such as wind and solar power credible output model is established, which considers the impact of demand side response on load forecasting results comprehensively. Base on this model, a multi-stage active distribution network planning model is constructed in this paper. To solve the problem that the existing intelligent algorithm is easy to converge to the local optimum, a Fibonacci tree optimization algorithm based on golden section method is proposed to solve this model. The results show that the proposed method can effectively reduce the planning cost and improve the planning effect.

articleTitle: The development of the system for adjusting the peak of the grid in Hebei province
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The ancillary services market for adjusting the peak of the grid is to adopt the principle of fair and voluntary. The power generation enterprise declares the will of adjusting the peak of the grid voluntarily, when the power grid have the demand. The dispatch department has cleared out optimized uniformly. Through market-oriented means the unit power generation plan is arranged and the units participated in power grid peak adjusting the peak of the grid is to compensate after the event. The peak of the grid auxiliary service technical support system in the province is developed based on the existing d5000 operation plan system and security check system function module. The main modules include data declaration, the auxiliary services trade management and settlement management, report management, information release, and ancillary services trading information display (III area), AGC adaptability reformation, external data interaction and so on.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Operation and Maintenance Knowledge Base for Power Metering Verification Device Based on LDA Model
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The manual operation and maintenance of the measurement verification device has the problems of low efficiency and error-prone. In this paper, a method for construction of the knowledge base of intelligent metering system is proposed based on the Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA). Through the fault similarity calculation method of cosine similarity, input fault phenomenon and output fault processing method, intelligent recommendation of fault processing method is realized. The actual application shows that this knowledge base can improve the operation and maintenance efficiency and reduce the operation and maintenance cost without affecting the measurement verification work.
