articleTitle: Key Technology Research of Distribution Automation System Based on Cloud Architecture
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: China's economic development has higher requirements for the power supply capability and reliability of distribution network. At present, the management scope of distribution automation system cannot cover the whole distribution network and many regional electric companies cannot manage the operation state of distribution network through the existing distribution automation system, which restricts the development of distribution network construction. It is necessary to develop a new system construction scheme to cope with the different data capacity and function requirements of distribution networks in different cities. This paper proposes a technical scheme of main station of distribution automation system based on cloud architecture in aspects of system architecture, elastic data processing, safe access of distribution terminals and optimal operation control. With the distributed collaboration between core cloud and regional cloud as well as data fragmentation parallel processing technology, the problem of massive access and application of distribution network will be solved.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Community Planning Based on Bi-Level optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the development of economy, how to use energy efficiently and reduce the cost of energy has become an urgent problem. Different energy systems are planned and operated separately without coordination and linkage. Although cogeneration technology improves the energy efficiency of power plants, it also restricts the power output regulation capacity of thermal power units. In order to ensure heating in winter in northern China, the lack of flexibility of thermal power units hinders the large-scale access of renewable energy, resulting in a serious problem of wind curtailment. In this paper, the energy community with combined heat and power supply as the core can effectively improve the energy utilization rate and energy supply flexibility, while considering the planning economy and minimum wind curtailment rate. Aiming at the minimum annual total cost of investment cost, operation cost, operation and maintenance cost and wind curtailment penalty cost of the energy community, and considering the balance constraint of power supply and heat supply in the energy community. A multi-objective bi-level optimization model of energy community including CHP unit, wind power generation, heat storage, electric boiler and heat pump is established. The upper level takes the lowest annual cost as the goal, the installation capacity of each equipment as the optimization variable, the lower level takes the lowest annual operation cost as the goal, and the scheduling value of each period of equipment as the optimization variable. In the process of planning and solving, the elite retention strategy genetic algorithm is used to solve the upper model, and the lower model is solved by the function fmincon in the MATLAB optimization toolbox. The results of an energy community in North China show that the energy community planning can effectively reduce the operating cost and the wind curtailment rate, improve the utilization rate of renewable energy, bring obvious economic benefits, and verify the effectiveness and rationality of the planning method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Power Signal Parameter Estimation Based on Central Difference Strong Tracking Kalman Filter Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the strong tracking Kalman filter algorithm needs to calculate the Jacobian matrix, the convergence speed is slow and the algorithm estimation accuracy is low in power signal parameter estimation. This paper proposes a central difference strong tracking Kalman filter algorithm. The algorithm uses the first derivative term of the nonlinear differential center polynomial to estimate the pre-test and post-test error covariance matrix and the fading factor in the filtering process in real time. The proposed algorithm simplifies the calculation process more traditionally, avoids the need to solve the Jacobian matrix in the filtering process, and improves the convergence speed and estimation accuracy of the algorithm after the system parameters are abrupt. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm improves the parameter estimation accuracy and calculation speed, and verifies the effectiveness of the algorithm in power signal parameter estimation.

articleTitle: Research on Auxiliary Decision Method of Power Dispatching Based on Intelligent Preplan
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the current power dispatching business, in order to ensure that power grid accidents can be dealt with in a timely manner, dispatchers need to prepare a large number of accident plans for the typical operation mode of the power grid. However, as the scale of the power grid continues to increase, the complexity of abnormal handling of accidents gradually increases, and it is increasingly difficult for typical failure plans to meet the needs of dispatchers. This article will study the method of intelligent plan preparation, aiming at different typical ways to automatically generate plans for single component accidents and complex system accidents, and based on the results of intelligent plan preparation, through the analysis of real-time data and status of the power grid, research on power dispatching auxiliary decision methods, The actual operation of the power system provides online intelligent assistant decision-making, reduces the complexity of power grid status analysis, and improves the accuracy of dispatchers in handling accidents.

articleTitle: Research on coordinated dispatching of wind power consumption in integrated energy system based on flexible equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Due to the randomness and volatility of wind power output, large-scale integration of wind power intensifies the phenomenon of wind power curtailment and power limitation, resulting in serious waste of clean energy of wind power. From the point of view of improving system flexibility, this paper takes CHP, electric boiler and heat storage device as the flexible equipment of integrated energy system, and constructs a coordinated dispatching model of comprehensive energy system with various flexible equipment for wind curtailment and absorption. The model takes into account the operation cost and purchasing cost of the system. In order to reduce wind power curtailment rate, the curtailment wind penalty cost is added to the target. Through the analysis of a variety of heating modes, based on meeting a certain load and heat load, the daily scheduling plan is optimized by minimizing the cost of the system as the goal. The influence of adding flexible equipment on wind power curtailment is analyzed. The results show that the model can improve the wind power consumption capacity and system flexibility.

articleTitle: Development of Hybrid Energy Absorption Device Based on Voltage Level Adaptive
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: According to different electric lines of rail transit using different voltage level vehicles, the traditional solution is to use different voltage level devices for different voltage level vehicles to manually switch the line; it means high cost and low debugging automation. In this paper, a hybrid energy absorption device and a voltage level adaptive scheme are proposed. The system control principle is introduced, the system simulation model is established, and its function and performance are verified by a prototype. The results show that the hybrid energy absorption device can make full use of braking energy and stabilize the traction network voltage under the condition of rapid absorption. At the same time, the efficiency of production and debugging is improved.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Monthly Line Loss Calculate and Improvement with Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Line loss calculating is a very important problem, not only for the researchers to solve progressively, but also for power companies to reduce cost and save energy. Because of the complexity and uncertainty of distribution network structure in some countries, such as China, it gives us such a big challenge to find specific methods to calculate the theoretical line loss of a certain aera, especially by utilizing load flow calculation or other traditional methods, let alone make refine strategies and delicacy management, including power theft and leakage detection or line loss evaluation system development, etc., based on the calculation results. Based on the situation mentioned above, we create a new method by mapping the relationship of timing feature into the location of specific size picture, then use convolutional neural network to extract information from the image data to help us calculate the line loss interval and build up reasonable line loss evaluation system. Finally, a simulation model is generated and verified by using TensorFlow deep learning framework. Results fully show good accuracy and practicability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Study on Risk Control Strategy of Power Grid Material Quality under Moral Hazard Condition
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The quality of the power grid materials directly delivered to the construction site cannot be fully recognized by grid companies, and the suppliers will be driven by interests to violate the contract by cutting corners. Due to the lack of effective inspection of material quality, grid companies indirectly promote the increase of supplier moral hazard, and the material quality and safety risks increase accordingly. Based on the principal-agent theory, this paper studies the problem of how to control the quality risk of power grid materials under the condition of moral hazard, establishes a decision-making model of quality control for grid companies and suppliers, and considers the individual rational constraints of grid companies and suppliers, and makes an optimal solution to the model. The results show that under the moral hazard environment, the quality supervision of grid companies and the penalties for breach of contract and the quality control level of suppliers are different from the decision results under the condition of symmetric information. When the quality control level of suppliers is determined, the size of moral hazard depends on the difference between the internal quality assurance payment and the external quality assurance payment paid by the suppliers to the grid companies. The larger the difference, the greater the moral hazard. Grid companies should take into account their own income levels and control the moral hazard of suppliers, strengthen material quality supervision and management, increase the penalties for supplier’s breach of contract, and promote the healthy development of the grid material procurement market.

articleTitle: Data-driven fault risk warning method for distribution system
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A data-driven method for fault risk prediction of distribution network is proposed. Firstly, data analysis are carried out to determine the target classification and the correlation feature set of the distribution network failure. The Adaboost-SVM algorithm is presented to forecast the distribution network faults and excavates the relationship between the failure and the influencing factors. The calculation results show that the fault warning method is effective and provide significant reference to the operation practice.

articleTitle: Design of harmonic control and reactive power compensation scheme in a pipe fitting factory
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In recent years with the rapid development of national economy and the wide application of power electronic technology, the various departments of various nonlinear disturbance load fast growth, rapid growth in high power system harmonic content, cause the voltage waveform distortion, increased the line loss and loss of electrical equipment, reduces the power quality, frequent accidents caused interruption of power supply equipment, its direct or indirect losses of one hundred million yuan. It is of great significance to do a good job in the management of high harmonics for the development of industrial production. In accordance with the requirements of a pipe fitting factory for harmonic control and reactive power compensation, the work principle of intermediate frequency heating pipe bender and the generated harmonic components are comprehensively analyzed, and the harmonic control scheme of pipe fitting factory is described in detail. The installation capacity of the capacitor is determined by calculating the base wave compensation capacity of the capacitor. Carry on the reasonable filter loop design, make the PCC point reach the target after the governance;According to the working principle of FS-SY device, the harmonic management and reactive power compensation design are implemented. The harm of harmonic pollution to the power system is very serious. It not only reduces the efficiency of power transmission, overheats the electrical equipment and produces noise, but also makes its insulation aging and even causes failure or burnout. Therefore, the design of harmonic control and reactive power compensation is the key part. The scheme designed by a certain pipe fitting factory can guarantee the quality and reliability of power supply and has practical application value.

articleTitle: A precondition generalized minimization residual method based on GPU for static security analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In power system, in order to avoid equipment damage caused by overload and over voltage, fast online real-time static Security analysis (SSA) is very important. With power system expanding constantly, the scale of power grid is getting bigger and bigger, which even reach tens of thousands nodes. Therefore, the number of states that need to be calculated is huge, and the traditional serial computing method can’t meet the real-time computing requirements of large power grid any more. The expected fault set increases greatly, resulting in a larger computational burden. To solve this problem, A generalized minimization residual method (GMRES) based on GPU for SSA is proposed. First, the SSA is conducted in coarse-grained parallel, and the power flow calculation in each fault case are allocated by thread. Then, the solution of the modified equation and the formation of the Jacobian matrix in the process of each power flow are designed in a fine-grained parallel way to improve the computing speed and achieve a better acceleration effect. For the solution of the modified equation, due to its large scale and sparse mode, the iterative method is adopted to solve it. In view of the situation that the Jacobian matrix is asymmetric and positive definite, the internal iteration method adopts the generalized minimization residual (GMRES) method to further accelerate the internal iteration convergence. Incomplete LU precondition method further improves the efficiency of fine grain parallelism. At the same time, the Jacobian matrix with high computing time is parallelized to achieve the best overall acceleration effect. Compared with CPU serial calculation, the acceleration effect of parallel large-scale power system SSA based on GPU can reach a large acceleration ratio, and the acceleration ratio of case2383 power system can reach more than 6.17 times.

articleTitle: Control Strategy and Stability Assessment of Microgrid-based Flexible Loads
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As a kind of flexible load with bi-directional energy interaction, microgrid (MG) can deliver power when power converters operate in grid-feeding mode. Grid-feeding inverters can be controlled as a current source. This paper analyses the control strategy of grid-feeding power converters in an MG, develops an impedance model of the system with multiple parallel current-source-based inverters(VSIs). Further, an impedance reshaping approach is proposed to enhance the stability of MGs as flexible loads. The approach is validated by simulation results.

articleTitle: Design of Interactive and Intelligent Electrical Heating Service Management Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to solve the impact problems of large-scale electrical heating accessing to power grid, this paper designs the framework and main functions of electrical heating service management platform facing both sides of power grid and customers. The basic information base, model base, rule base and security protection system are constructed by using system control theory. The platform is designed by using large data analysis, intelligent application and block chain technology. The functions of grid-side and customer-side platforms are presented, and the design grid load regulation based on incentive mechanism are put forward. It is of great significance to reduce energy consumption cost on customer-side, realize direct electricity transaction on grid-side and load regulation on grid-side, and has broad application prospects.

articleTitle: Optimization and Coordination Research in Harmonic Control
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposes a method for suppressing harmonics in a distributed power system through gridconnected power generation of power electronic devices. A method for suppressing harmonics using a distributed active filter system（DAFS）is proposed. The configuration and connection are optimized through multiple active power filters(APF) into the multi-harmonic source grid, so that the harmonic distortion rate of the entire line is the lowest. In order to ensure stable long-term operation of the shunt active filter, droop control is introduced to improve, so as to achieve load power sharing and suppression of circulating current, and maintain line voltage distortion rate at a low level. The final simulation results illustrate the validity and validity of the theory.

articleTitle: Study on resistance to tracking of epoxy resin micron composites
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to study the effect of micron silica on the surface resistance of epoxy insulating materials and improve the resistance of epoxy resin micron composites, three kinds of epoxy resin composites doped with different micron silica particles were prepared. By using the ASTM D2132-62T test method, the resistance of epoxy micron composites was evaluated by recording the time of electrical mark failure. The hydrophobicity of the sample was studied by static contact angle measurement, and the electrical and mechanical properties of the sample were tested. The results show that with the increase of the doping content of micron silica particles, the resistance to electrical marks and hydrophobicity of the samples become better, The dielectric constant of the sample decreases first and then increases, the dielectric loss is constant, the volume resistance decreases first and then increases, but the dielectric strength increases first and then decreases, and the difference of electrical properties of different samples is small. both the bending strength and the tensile strength are slightly increased, and the impact strength decreases first and then increases. the comprehensive test of the electrical and mechanical properties of the specimen increases the bending strength and tensile strength of the specimen, appropriately reduces the dielectric constant and volume resistivity, and increases the dielectric strength, which can make the resistance of epoxy micron composites better.

articleTitle: Target Registration of Electric Power Installation Based on Hybrid Network Model Under the Application of Intelligent Inspection Application
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the on-line monitoring of power equipment, it is necessary to identify the appearance image of the target, and the image fault recognition must first carry out the accurate matching of the image, so there is an increasingly urgent demand for the application technology of the visual positioning of the target detection equipment. In this paper, a hybrid network model based target seeking algorithm for power equipment is proposed, which combines two research routes: template matching of twin network and image registration based on feature point matching. In the aspect of network depth, the algorithm uses less feature size compression to reduce pooling. In order to ensure that the size of the feature map is the same as that of the original image, the detection resolution can be reduced. Methods the sub neighborhood partition of feature descriptor is improved to simplify the algorithm complexity. In order to avoid over fitting of the model, dropout strategy was used to ignore some neurons randomly during training. At the same time, the exponential descent learning rate curve is used to consider the convergence speed of the model in the early stage and the convergence in the later stage. The experimental results show that the algorithm can achieve the goal-seeking task of power equipment reliably and effectively in the complex and changeable substation detection environment.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimization by non-dominationsearching based NSGA-II Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The core elements of THE NSGA-II algorithm are genetic search and non-dominant sorting based on elite retention strategy It belongs to passive search and lacks an active search mechanism. In some cases, it will affect the efficiency of the algorithm in searching for the optimal Pareto front. According to the distribution characteristics of each generation of population samples, this paper calculates the non-dominated direction of the Pareto front from the solution set with Pareto ranks 1 and 2 in the population of that generation, and actively searches for a step toward the non-dominated direction from each sample of the Pareto front to find the better Non-dominant may solve and participate in the next generation of subgroup reconstruction. In the experimental verification, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified through classic calculation examples and multi-objective optimization problems after power grid black start.

articleTitle: Study on the influence of lubricants on the interface partial discharge of Silicon rubber/epoxy
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, the impact of lubricants coating on interfacial partial discharge characteristics of epoxy resin/silicone rubber was studied under different interface roughness. The results showed that the interfacial roughness of epoxy/silicone rubber, partial discharge inception voltage(IV) and extinction voltage (EV) remains the same, and silicone coating had little effect on it. The partial discharge quantity Q is greatly affected by the interface roughness. In the case of no silicone grease coating, the discharge quantity Q decreases with the decrease of roughness, while in the case of silicone grease coating, the discharge quantity Q increases with the decrease of roughness. The analysis suggests that the reason for the above phenomenon may be the existence of interface charge. The higher the trap depth at the interface, the longer the charge retention time and the greater the influence on PD. The influence mechanism of Interface charge on partial discharge is still unclear and further experimental study is needed.

articleTitle: Automatic power control method of regional power grid considering voltage control electrolytic aluminum load
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Automatic power control system (APC) is a set of real-time control system based on the upgrade of automatic generation control (AGC) system. The system regulates the generator and other active power adjustable equipment uniformly. Electrolytic aluminum (EA) load is a kind of adjustable equipment with great adjustable potential. This paper proposes a set of APC system architecture considering EA load, and describes the functions of each module, data interaction content and operation process of APC system. According to the power consumption characteristics of EA load, the equivalent model of EA load is built, the control constraints are refined, and the control strategy is proposed and applied to APC. Finally, APC system considering EA load is deployed on a provincial dispatching platform in Northwest China, and simulation is carried out based on Northwest power grid model. According to the simulation results, the influence on the control performance and reserve capacity is analyzed.

articleTitle: Integrated Reliability Analysis of Power Distribution Network and Urban Road Network
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the development of electric vehicles (EVs) and increased energy interaction, there is increasing need for accurate assessment of the integrated reliability of the energy Internet, which includes the power distribution network and the urban road network. This study examined the relevant concepts of power distribution network and urban road network reliability and selected important evaluation indicators. Game theory was used to analyze the power distribution and urban road networks. The network information was then combined with the charge-discharge characteristics and behavior characteristics of the EVs for an integrated reliability analysis. Finally, the changes of the integrated reliability index of the urban road network and power distribution network were assessed after optimizing the driving behavior of EVs, to illustrate the accuracy and practicability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Analysis of Substation 35kV Reactance Switch Fault Based on ATP-EMTP
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper Initial on the solar parabolic trough collectors…Operating overvoltage is a common overvoltage in the power system, and it is closely related to the operation mode of the power grid and equipment characteristics etc. Normal equipment in the system has a large insulation margin. Operating overvoltage can not cause damage to it, but it can pose a greater threat to equipment with weak insulation, which will affect the safe operation of the power grid. In the paper, a simulation was produced based on the electromagnetic transient simulation software ATP-EMTP for the 35kV reactance fault in a substation. The overvoltages subjected to the reactance and its switching equipment are analyzed , and the causes of the equipment damage were analyzed in detail. A reference treatment plan is proposed to provide guidance for practice.

articleTitle: Nonintrusive Voltage Measurement Method for Power Overhead Lines
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The development of smart and efficient power grid is an inevitable trend in the future <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>. Smart grid needs a flexible, stable and secure energy network, but also needs real-time measurement and dynamic adjustment of power grid state quantities, so as to realize smart sense of information and intelligent self-healing of faults in power grid <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[2]</sup>. Voltage is one of the most important state quantities in power grid. At present, potential transformers commonly used in power grid have many disadvantages, such as large volume, heavy weight, high cost and single function, which make it difficult to meet the requirements of digitalization, miniaturization, and low cost for sensors in smart grid <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[3]</sup>. In recent years, new voltage measurement technologies and electric field sense materials have developed rapidly. There are plenty of researches on electric field sense chip based on piezoelectric material, which is suitable for voltage measurement in smart grid <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[4]</sup>. A voltage measurement method for overhead line based on electric field sense chip is proposed in this paper. The voltage value can be calculated without any contact with the overhead line by applying this method, which requires no high voltage insulation, and no magnetic core and coil neither. This method lays a theoretical foundation for the development of micro smart voltage sensor. Simulation models of two different scenes were established and analyzed to verify the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: SSPE Prosumer Development in China’s Electricity Grids and Markets
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the development of global energy transition, prosumers with both electricity generation and consumption become increasingly popular, making the electricity market reform and grid operation more and more complex. Design of future electricity market should fully consider the electrical and economic features of various electricity prosumers. This paper focuses on the traditional prosumer--Self-Supply Power Station Enterprise (SSPE) in the background of present China's electricity market. In China, most regional SSPEs were set up for industrial productions with coal-fired power plants. The future development of SSPE with energy transition is discussed. For SSPE’s participation in electricity market, an economical model of SSPE and progressive market are proposed.

articleTitle: Pole-to-ground Fault Analysis for the DC Distribution System Considering the VSC Control Modes
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In DC distribution system, the unblocked converters after line faults can improve the reliability of DC power supply. The fault mechanism considering unblocked converters is affected by the control modes of converters. In this paper, with the promise that the converters will not be locked after fault, the fault mechanism and characteristics of pole-to-ground fault under the constant DC voltage control, constant AC active power control and droop control are analyzed. The conduction process of diodes and IGBTs with unblocked VSCs are analyzed. The simulation analysis is carried out on the PSCAD/EMTDC platform. The study of the fault mechanism can provide a theoretical basis for the protection of the DC distribution system.

articleTitle: Analysis on latency performance of power distribution control services over security protected wireless communication channel
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper conducts analysis on latency performance of power distribution control services over security protected wireless communication channel. An end-to-end power distribution control service flow is developed on a hardware-in-the-loop evaluation platform, with security protection equipment including isolation and encryption devices. Service packets are all tagged with a time mark, indicating the initial and travelling time of different service process including encryption, forward and backward isolation, data transmission, data processing, thus the detailed latency performance could be obtained. The results would be essential to determine the security protection topology and functional parameters to guarantee the reliable and safe operation of power distribution services.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Condition Monitoring System for Distribution Substation Based on Integrated Sensing Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Recently, the intelligent construction of distribution station is still in its infancy. Information is not fused between different monitoring systems. The current investment in distribution network detection means is large, which does not match the low-cost characteristics of distribution network equipment. So information isolation and high cost are the two main restrains of condition monitoring. Aiming at solving these problems, this paper proposes a new monitoring system for power distribution station in the context of the ubiquitous power Internet of things. Firstly, the overall design of the system is studied. A highly integrated comprehensive monitoring terminal is developed, based on the idea of integrated perception. It can reduce monitoring and communication costs through the flexible access and efficient processing of key state parameters such as sound, light, electricity, and heat. Secondly, algorithms are developed for evaluation and diagnosis of power distribution equipment. Artificial intelligence and big data analysis methods were used for condition evaluation and anomaly detection. It improves the efficiency of fault handling. Finally, the monitoring systems are applied in some power distribution stations. After a period of application, the system cross-professional data are fully integrated and multiple state parameters are obtained in real time for comprehensive application. In conclusion, this work can provide new solutions for the construction of intelligent power distribution stations.

articleTitle: Automatic Detection Method of Power Communication Network Breakpoint Data under Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper presents two methods based on neural network and clustering analysis are used to automatically detect break-point data of power communication network. It has a low recall rate and hinders the realization of power network planning objectives. In view of the above situation, an automatic detection method of power communication network break-point data under cloud computing is studied. This method is divided into four parts. Firstly, the connection model is constructed by the omni-directional construction mode of FP-tree micro-cellular, then the break-point data signal is collected by network tracker. In addition, the break-point data signal is filtered by wavelet filtering method, and finally the break-point data of power communication network is automatically detected by firefly algorithm. The results show that, compared with the two detection methods based on neural network and clustering analysis. Additionally, the recall rate of this detection method is increased by 3.1% and 2.27%, basically realizing the goal of power grid planning.

articleTitle: Recurrent Faults Identification in Medium Voltage Distribution System for Fault Early Warning
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The subject addressed in this paper is identifying the recurrent faults from the recorded disturbance waveforms. The electrical equipment may experience self-clearing and instantaneous fault before the permanent faults occur, gradually reducing the insulation performance of the equipment. These faults are called incipient fault, which cannot be detected by the overcurrent relay for its low magnitude or short duration, but can occur many times before the permanent fault. At present, scholars have conducted related research of incipient faults. However, the causes of incipient fault may be different, it is difficult to apply these research methods to distribution fault early warning. Meanwhile, some incipient faults imply the high correlation and the same underlying causes. Such faults refer to recurrent faults . Therefore, recurrent faults identification should be finished before analyzing their cumulative effect on the permanent fault. Identification of these recurrent faults will facilitate distribution fault early warning and contributing to improving power supply reliability.

articleTitle: Optimized functional design and simulation study of the fault line selection devices for non-solidly earthed network based on RTDS
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The action accuracy of the fault line selection device is of great significance for ensuring the safe operation of the power system and personal safety. In view of the current imperfect function and the low accuracy of the small current grounding line selection device, the function of line selection of the device is further optimally designed and studied, and the post-acceleration and wheel-cutting functions are put forward and realized. The RTDS simulation model of non-solidly earthed network is established and connected with the actual grounding line selection device to form a closed-loop real-time simulation testing system. By setting up various test items, different types of ground fault test of non-solidly earthed net-work are carried out. The results of simulation show the accuracy of the line selection function, which provides important technical guidance for the implementation of the fault line selection device.

articleTitle: Real-time metering data collection for industrial and commercial users
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the development of new businesses such as electricity spot trading, load dispatching, and marketing user interaction, the metering automation systems have put forward new requirements for data acquisition types and real-time acquisition of large industrial and commercial users. The current metering automation system has certain limitations on data acquisition type expansion, real-time performance and flexibility improvement. This paper introduces a new data acquisition method, which can meet the requirements of rapid response to business data acquisition under complex and changeable business conditions, and can meet the requirements of data type expansion, real-time acquisition, rapid system upgrade and so on.

articleTitle: Research on Integration Optimization of Integrated Energy System Planning and Operation Based on Model Linearization
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In response to the needs of park-level integrated energy planning, this paper establishes the linearization input and output models of energy conversion components for photovoltaic, wind generations, electric heating boilers, heat pumps, refrigerators, CCHP (combined cooling, heat and power), gas boilers, and energy storage components for electric energy storage, heat storage, and cooling storage. The multi-energy flow coupling input and output matrix for electricity, cooling, heat and gas is put forward to describe the coupling relationship of conversion, distribution and storage for multi-energy flows. Taking economic optimization as objective, equipment capacity and operation boundaries as constraints, a bi-level iterative mixed integer optimization planning method for integrated energy planning and operation is proposed. The case study shows that the method proposed in this paper is able to support the optimal planning of the integrated energy system planning and operation.

Author Keywords: integration optimization of planning and operation

articleTitle: Research on Economic Operation Strategy of AC / DC Hybrid Distribution Network Based on Power Electronic Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Multi-port Power Electronic Transformer (PET) can establish a flexible power circulation path in the AC/DC hybrid power distribution network to achieve inter-regional energy interconnection and mutual support. This paper proposes an economic operation strategy of AC/DC hybrid distribution network based on multi-port PET. Firstly, based on the typical topology of the AC/DC hybrid distribution network, the flexible regulation capability of the AC/DC distribution network including PET is analyzed. Then, according to the physical constraints during the operation of PET, the power flow relationship of each port of multi-port PET is analyzed, and the energy flow model of PET in the hybrid distribution network is established. Finally, taking the lowest operation cost of the AC/DC hybrid distribution network as the objective function, and taking the system power balance, power flow limit violation and equipment operation as constraints, the day-ahead economic operation model of the AC/DC hybrid distribution network is established and a model solving method based on CPLEX solver is proposed. Taking an AC/DC hybrid distribution network demonstration project in a certain area as an example, the day-ahead economic operation model of the demonstration project is established and solved. The calculation results show that the proposed PET-based AC / DC hybrid distribution network economic operation strategy can effectively reduce the system operation cost and increase the level of renewable energy accommodation.

articleTitle: Static Security Analysis of Source-Side High Uncertainty Power Grid Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As a large amount of renewable energy is injected into the power grid, the source side of the power grid becomes extremely uncertain. Traditional static safety analysis methods based on pure physical models can no longer quickly and reliably give analysis results. Therefore, this paper proposes a deep learning-based static security analytical method. First, the static security assessment index of the power grid under the N-1 principle is proposed. Secondly, a neural network model and its input and output data for static safety analysis problems are designed. Finally, the validity of the proposed method was verified by IEEE grid data. Experiments show that the proposed method can quickly and accurately give the static security analysis results of the source-side high uncertainty grid.

articleTitle: Research on Operation Mechanism and Implementation Approach of Multi-energy Complementary System in the Park
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As the main body of energy supply, the park needs to integrate various energy sources such as electric power, fossil energy, and thermal energy in the regional system. The integrated energy system is an important means to achieve "multiple energy complementarity and coordinated development of source, grid, storage, and storage" in the industrial park. This paper explores the external development environment of multi-energy complementarity in the park and the current status of domestic and foreign pilots, and provides a reference for my country's extensive implementation of the multi-energy complementarity system in the park. Taking the park's multi-energy complementary system as an object, analyze the development status of the park's multi-energy complementary system, and carry out analysis of the operating characteristics of the park's multi-energy complementary system, specifically from the analysis of operating scenarios and clarify the park under the multi-condition coupling of operation mode, capacity configuration and user type Analyze and discuss several aspects of the operating scenario. This article puts forward the function of implementing multi-energy complementary system in the park, and establishes the basic operation mechanism of the multi-energy complementary system in the park, which lays a theoretical foundation for the in-depth study of the multi-energy complementary system in the park to participate in the integration of clean energy.

articleTitle: Research on the Maximum Penetration Capacity of Distributed PV Based on Firework Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: For the maximum penetration capacity problem of distributed PV, a computational model with power equation, node voltage, line capacity and distributed PV capacity as the main constraints is established, and an improved firework algorithm is proposed to solve the above model. Based on the semi-positive cloud generator to improve the explosion spark generation method, a large number of displacement deviations with stable propensity and randomness are obtained, increasing the population diversity and speeding up the convergence; the dimensional difference strategy is used to improve the variance operator, which is conducive to the search for the late jump out local optimum. Apply the algorithm to the CIGER6 Task Force system and verify the validity of the algorithm. The results show that the proposed algorithm is able to solve the penetration level calculation problem of distributed PV.

articleTitle: Analysis of distribution network failure in plateau area
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the development of electric power, people have higher and higher requirements for the quality of power grid, the awareness of power consumption is enhanced, and higher requirements for power reliability are put forward. However, the quality of grid structure in plateau area is poor, there are many demands for work orders for fault emergency repair, and the fault causes emerge in endlessly. This paper analyzes the fault emergency repair of distribution network in plateau area, the classification statistics of fault causes, and the analysis of main fault causes Put forward preventive measures for failure causes.

articleTitle: Real Time Simulation Test Platform for Distribution Network Coordinated Control
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Distribution network coordinated control technology realizes active control of bidirectional power flow in distribution network by dispatching distributed generation (DG) and energy storage system (ESS), and improves the ability of distribution network to absorb intermittent energy. Perfect monitoring and control system is the key to realize the coordinated control of the distribution network. This paper analyzes the test requirements of the distribution network control system, and proposes a test platform based on DIgSILENT. The implementation method of the platform interface is discussed. Typical scenarios of demonstration project is taken as examples to test the controller and the master station, and verifies the effectiveness of the test platform by comparing with the simulation results.

articleTitle: Research on Optimizing the Stability of Impulse Voltage Calibrator used in Traceability
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Impulse Voltage Calibrator is important equipment in traceability of impulse voltage measurement. The characteristic of impulse voltage calibrator directly affects the accuracy and reliability of impulse voltage measurement. The output voltage parameters of standard calibrator will be changed after long-term operation. In order to optimize the stability and reduce the temperature rise of the calibrator, constant temperature control scheme of impulse calibrator is proposed. The parameters of (1.56/60) μs calibrator were selected to study. The results show that the long-term stability parameters of the standard impulse voltage source are improved by 0.04% and the accuracy of impulse voltage traceability is effectively improved after temperature control of the temperature.

articleTitle: Power Ancillary Service Option - Coupling Optimization of the High Back-pressure Unit and Cogeneration Unit
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Presently the high back-pressure cogeneration unit utilizing the condensing heat as the heating source, has high power output under high heating load and poor peaking load performance. The coupling optimization of the high back-pressure unit and cogeneration unit is proposed as one option for improving the peaking load performance of power plant in power market. Coupling operation of the two units are optimized and analyzed based on established models of 350MW cogeneration unit with heating steam extraction and high back-pressure cogeneration unit using Ebsilon software, and special attention is paid to the change of peak load regulation performance and total economic benefit of the two units. Two scenarios are analyzed for the two example cogeneration units during night period. The calculation results show that compared with Scenario I the total peak load regulation depth can be increased by 38.77 MW while the total heating load remains unchanged at 600 MW in Scenario II, and the average total loading rate of the two units can be decreased from 54.2% to 48.7%, which means 5.5% deeper peaking load improvement using the proposed technique. Taking all revenues and costs into consideration, the total economic benefit of the two units will be decreased by 1.03×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> Yuan/h by application of the proposed technique in Scenario II, which is corresponding to 0.2657 Yuan/kWh compensation standard or compensation cost for the proposed technique. Since adoption of the proposed technique doesn’t involve any technical upgrading of the existing units and extra investment, the expected performance improvement will reduce the uncertainty of future application prospect for the proposed technique.

articleTitle: Design and Application of On-line Monitoring System for Hybrid HVDC Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: An on-line monitoring system of hybrid HVDC circuit breaker is designed. Through on-line monitoring of characteristic parameters such as mechanical switches, power electronic switches and MOA of hybrid HVDC circuit breaker, analysis and evaluation of operation status and fault trend of hybrid HVDC circuit breaker are realized. The classification method and evaluation index of monitoring system are studied, and extracting method of monitoring indicators is put forward, then the system architecture, the procedure of monitoring and the process of evaluation is described. Finally, the application deployment effect of the online monitoring system shows that the monitoring system can effectively evaluate the operation status of the high-voltage DC circuit breaker, and it provide an effective monitoring means for the high-voltage DC circuit breaker.

articleTitle: Power Decoupling Control of VSC-HVDC Systems Connected to a Weak Grid
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: When the voltage source converter based high voltage direct current (VSC-HVDC) system is connected to an AC weak grid, the power coupling will impose the challenge to the stability and controllability of the power system. This paper derives the linear model of dual loop controlled VSC. Based on developed linear model, coupling characteristics of VSC-HVDC system are revealed in two aspects of phase lock loop (PLL) and power control loop under a weak grid condition. Furthermore, it proposed a power decoupling control strategy. Simulation studies have verified the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: On-line Monitoring of Transportation Condition for 110kV Vehicular Mobile Transformers
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In recent years, vehicular mobile transformer has been increasingly widely used in emergency power supply during equipment failure, natural disaster and alternative operational maintenance. Therefore, the safe transportation of vehicular mobile transformers is of great importance to power grid. In this paper, a transportation condition monitoring system for vehicular mobile transformers is introduced and developed. The transportation process of a 110kV/40MVA vehicular mobile transformer is monitored from the manufacturer in Jiangsu Province to the operating unit in Guangdong Province from 19:15 on December 12, 2018 to 14:00 on December 13, 2018. The geo-location, driving speed, vibration and shock acceleration in six different road sections are obtained in real time. Results show that the driving speed is highly correlated with the road section and the vibration and shock acceleration is highly correlated with the driving speed. The three-axis acceleration amplitude and the acceleration frequency are relatively high on highway and relatively low on service area. The amplitude of Y-axis vibration and shock acceleration is generally the lowest among the three-axis accelerations.

articleTitle: Methodology for Model Validation Applied to Advanced Distribution Management System
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A model validation methodology applicable to the advanced distribution management system is proposed, to guarantee the integrated common information model (CIM)-based distribution network model are reliable for the distribution management and optimization. The validation test rules for gross error detection, equipment unit consistency check, topology consistency check, time series consistency check and tempo-spatial consistency check are analyzed. A consistency check tool is implemented to apply the methodology. Finally, some results are obtained with the consistency check tool for a simulated case study to verify the proposed methodology

articleTitle: Boundary Equivalent Model of the Behind-The-Meter Distributed Energy Resource Based on Integration of DA and AMI
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The distributed energy resources (DERs) in the distribution network include distributed generation, energy storage, electric vehicles, flexible loads, etc. Most of these DERs are located behind the meter and are not visible to the system operators. With the increased penetration of DERs, the system operators wish to take the behine-the-meter (BTM) DER into the distribution restoration scheme to enhance the resilience of the distribution network. This anticipation will be based on the correct equivalence of the BTM DER at the boundary of distribution automation. A method for modeling the BTM DER is proposed, to train the BTM DER model based on the Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) meter readings with a generative adversarial network, and to modify the equivalent model based on Distribution Automation (DA) measurements. The wind and photovoltaic power profile from NREL integration data sets and the residential dataset from the reference energy disaggregation data set are used to demonstrate the performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Time Series Regulation Model of Aggregate Load of Distribution Network Based on Characteristic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Considering the influence of factors like new energy access, flexible load regulation, virtual electrical field, and demand response on the operation of the distribution network, the ‘bottom-up’ modeling method is adopted to propose a quasi-steady-state mechanism model including flexible load, virtual electrical field, and demand response resource. Based on the mechanism model, we proposed the response timing characteristics, load characteristics, and complementary characteristics of different resources. Taking into account the uncertainty of distributed new energy output, we proposed a time sequence adjustment model by Monte Carlo, scene reduction, and other methods for the aggregated load of the distribution network, according to the analysis of the characteristics of the flexible load, virtual electrical field, demand response, and other resources.

articleTitle: Cause Analysis and Probability Determination Method of Circuit Breaker Opening Failure
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The circuit breaker is one of the most important equipment in power system, and the characteristics of opening and closing are the key indexes to evaluate the operation of circuit breaker. If the circuit breaker refuses to break down in the process of operation, it may cause a large area power failure, even threaten personal safety. Aiming at the opening breakdown of the circuit breaker in a substation during the operation mode conversion process, the causes of the opening breakdown of circuit breaker are comprehensively analyzed in this paper. The effective measures are taken to ensure the reliability of its opening, and corresponding rectification measures are put forward. A method of determining the opening failure probability of the circuit breaker is proposed. According to the opening failure probability, the hidden dangers that may lead to the opening failure of the circuit breaker are eliminated in advance, and the opening failure of the circuit breaker is effectively prevented.

articleTitle: The Research on Joint Condition Diagnosis of Arrester in Distribution Network based on Live-line Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Live-line Monitoring for Power Grid Equipment is to obtain the device status information directly with detection device and monitoring device under the situation of non-stopping power, so as to scientific judgment the equipment health. Compared with traditional patrol inspection and power failure test, live monitoring has significant advantages in detecting potential hidden dangers of equipment. Based on the analysis of the performance and common faults in the distribution network arresters, this paper proposes three joint state diagnosis methods based on live monitoring. In the actual case, the comprehensive test and analysis of AC leakage current under the operating voltage, infrared temperature measurement, on-line monitoring data and power failure test data of distribution network arrester are carried out. Test data show that the arrester has defects. After the disassembly of the arrester, there are some defects in the arrester indeed. It is further confirmed that joint the AC leakage current, infrared temperature measurement and online monitoring data under the operating voltage can timely find the internal insulation defects of the arrester.

articleTitle: Measurement of Carbonization Traces Development by Partial Discharge Based on Distributed Voltage Signals
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: By the method of engraving a groove on the quartz glass plate, this paper artificially limits the development direction of carbonization channel, eliminating the interference of other directions. With the help of the distributed potential measurement system, and through actual measurement and simulation analysis, it is verified that the space charge generated by the discharge is the cause of the distortion of the distributed voltage waveform. Using the increment of waveform distortion measured at different positions, this paper gives a calculation method for calculating the position and the amount of space charge through theoretical formula derivation. Comparing the data which is calculated by this method in the test and the cardboard layered analysis, the correctness of calculation method is verified, and it is also proved that under this model, the position of space charge can largely characterize the length of the carbonization trace.

articleTitle: Fault analysis of the semi-insulated voltage transformer of distribution network caused by ferroresonance
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper Initial on the solar parabolic trough collectors…Semi-insulated voltage transformers are widely used in power distribution network. The safety of their own equipment directly affects the safe and stable operation of power system. In this paper, the fault diagnosis and analysis process of a semi-insulated voltage transformer is described in detail. In this paper, the fault course and the condition of the fault equipment are introduced at first, and then the cause of the fault is clarified through the electrical test and disassembly analysis combined with the action protection condition. Finally, the preventive measures for the daily operation and maintenance of the equipment are put forward.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Transient Characteristics of Grounding Fault Signals with Series Power Electronic Equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that how the series-type power electronic equipment affect the transient transition process of the faulty power systems under single-phase grounding fault, a 10kV small current grounding system model is built through MATLAB in this paper. An equivalent model of a series power electronic device using unified power flow controller (UPFC) is established. The UPFC will have varying degrees of influence on the transient duration, transient current and voltage amplitude, transient frequency and other electrical signals, when connected to the small current grounding system under single-phase grounding fault. It will further affect the sensitivity and reliability of the line selection method based on these transient electrical signals.

Author Keywords: Fault line selection and positioning technology

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Operation of Energy Service Provider for Flexible Load
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the continuous liberalization of the energy market, energy load aggregators and large users are bound to transform from traditional energy recipients to multiple participants with both energy purchase and sales capabilities. Therefore, the integrated demand response has broad de velopment prospects in the multi-energy market under the background of the energy Internet, and also directly affects the operation mechanism and trading results of the energy market. This paper takes energy service providers as the decision maker, analyzes the response characteristics and corresponding strategies of users' flexible loads and establishes a day-ahead energy price mechanism for a variety of user interaction resources.Firstly, models for the coordinated and optimized operation of the energy hub and for flexible load optimization under price guidance are established separately. And then a two-layer optimization model considering both user response decision-making and hub coordination optimization is constructed on a recent time scale. To convert the two-layer optimization model equivalently, the Lagrangian multiplier method and KKT conditions are used so that the equivalent single-layer MPEC model of the two-layer optimization problem is derived.An example is used to compare the energy supply situation of the energy center and the costs and benefits of the energy service provider under the consideration of the flexible load and without considering the flexible load. At the same time, the electricity price and heat price for each time period of the next day are formulated through optimization decisions to obtain the results of energy equipment scheduling. The conclusion can help optimize the demand curve of electric load and heat load, alleviate the output coupling problem of combined heat and power units to a certain extent, reduce the peak electricity price purchase power and the overall operating cost.

articleTitle: Discussion on the Future Development of Distribution Network from the Perspective of Vehicle Electrification
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper analyzes the reasons why the pure electric vehicle can win in the energy transition of vehicles and the reasons why the electric power system will promote the electrification of automobile. A three-phase AC fast charging scheme is proposed for the vehicle electrification. The main changes needed to be made by distribution network for vehicle electrification are discussed.

articleTitle: Research on Value Evaluation Index of Energy Internet Routing Considering Multi-energy Complement
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Energy Internet is regarded as the development form of smart grid in the future by realizing horizontal multi energy complementary and vertical highly coordinated "generation-grid-load-storage". In order to evaluate the effectiveness of regional energy Internet optimization, firstly, the energy sources and energy routers in the regional energy Internet are modeled. Then, the evaluation index of multi energy collaborative optimization is proposed from three aspects of economy, power loss and environmental benefits. Finally, based on a five-node regional energy Internet, the economic index are optimized and calculated, and the results verify the effectiveness of the proposed indexes.

articleTitle: Dielectric Properties of HFC-134a mixtures with CO<inf>2</inf> as a possible SF<inf>6</inf>-substitute gas
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Environmental friendly fluorinated compounds and their mixtures with CO<inf>2</inf> are considered as a typical category of SF<inf>6</inf>-substitute gases, due to their low global warming potentials and good dielectric strength. This paper investigates the breakdown characteristics and physical and chemical properties of HFC-134a (1,1,1,2,3,3,3-Heptafluor-opropane) and its mixtures theoretically and experimentally, which are compared with those of SF<inf>6</inf>. The results show that the HFC-134a mixtures with CO<inf>2</inf> are suitable for the power application with pressure 0.1 MPa, such as medium voltage power equipment. Espeically for the power application with 0.3MPa, the HFC-134a/CO<inf>2</inf> mixtures with the same pressure or a higher pressure could have equivalent insulation as SF<inf>6</inf>, whose GWPs are almost one twenty-third that of SF<inf>6</inf>. For the power application with 0.5 MPa, the HFC-134a/CO<inf>2</inf> mixtures with the liquefaction temperature -15°C and pressure 0.6 MPa could have equivalent insulation as SF<inf>6</inf>.

articleTitle: Research on influence factors and evaluation model of distribution network green index based on urban energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the development of urban energy Internet, the power, network, load and storage in the distribution network are becoming more and more complex. How to establish the distribution network green index evaluation system under the background of green development, energy revolution and energy Internet is a more complex issue. This paper firstly expounds the significance of establishing the distribution network green index based on urban energy Internet. Then it summarizes and analyzes the key influence factors of the distribution network green index. After that, this paper establishes the evaluation model by combining the interpretative structure model and Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP). Finally, it takes West-Hongqiao energy Internet demonstration area in Shanghai as an example to give a comprehensive distribution network green index evaluation.

articleTitle: Interconnectivity and interoperability-oriented communication converter for low voltage meter reading
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the development of smart grid construction, the domestic power user consumption information collection system is basically complete. In the current low-voltage meter reading system, most of the downlink channels use power line carrier and RS485 for communication. In the construction process over the years, the power line carrier technology has been updated rapidly, resulting in the coexistence of narrowband carrier, broadband carrier, high-speed carrier, and carrier wireless dual-mode technologies. In order to solve the problem of power line carrier interconnection and intercommunication of different technologies in the same station, this paper designs a low-voltage meter reading interconnection and intercommunication converter, which solves the problem of the communication module upgrade of station electric meters. And the converter can also support data collection after load switching across stations. Verified by field application, the device can effectively solve the problem of power line carrier interconnection in different technical systems.

articleTitle: Practice of “Reference Electricity Price + Floating Mechanism” in Yunnan Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Since the reform of electricity market in Yunnan province, Yunnan has continuously explored the price formation mechanism and improved the electricity market. Among them, the marketization pricing mechanism that has the widest scope and has a great influence in the whole country is the "Reference Electricity Price + Floating Mechanism". This paper discusses in detail the existing price linkage mechanism in Yunnan electricity market, compares the scope, advantages and disadvantages of different mechanisms. It shows that it can play a role in market allocation resources in a larger scope, and realize the "can rise and fall of the transaction price". The practice of Yunnan's electricity market shows that this mechanism can not only stabilize market prices, but also further expand the scale of transactions.

articleTitle: Medium-voltage Distribution Network Prospective Connection Planning Considering Multiple Transformation Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to meet the needs of refined grid planning of medium voltage distribution network and improvement of standardization requirements, this paper proposes a prospective wiring optimization model of medium voltage distribution network considering multiple transformation scenarios. Firstly, two types of typical wiring forms of the prospective grid are quantitatively described; Secondly, three types of transformming and planning solutions are classified and modeled. Pareto optimization is used to coordinate the two optimization goals of construction cost and retention of the current grid. Finally, the validity and practicability of the model are verified through the analysis of a numerical example

articleTitle: Probability prediction method of branch crossing risk based on gaussian mixture model
publicationTitle: 2021 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, a probability prediction method based on gaussian mixture model is proposed to predict the risk of branch exceeding the limit. Firstly, according to the minimum and maximum value of active power, each aggregate load in the regional power grid is divided into several sections, i.e. several states of aggregate load. Based on the high-order Markov chain technology, the probability distribution of the state vector of active power at the next time of aggregate load in the regional power grid is given. On this basis, the Gaussian mixture model of each aggregate load is established, and each state of active power of each aggregate load is regarded as a probability distribution in the Gaussian mixture model, thus the gaussian mixture model of active power of each aggregate load is established. Based on the road matrix, the probability distribution function of the active power of each branch of the regional power grid is given, and then the probability distribution function of the active power of the branch at the next time is obtained, which provides the probability information for judging the next time limit of the branch. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by an example.
